entry.title: New: RES23-248 (Honolulu) — CCL
entry.content:
ACCEPTING A GIFT OF TRAVEL, LODGING AND MEAL EXPENSES VALUED AT $1,437.50 TO THE CITY FROM THE URBAN SUSTAINABILITY DIRECTORS NETWORK (“USDN”) FOR THE EXECUTIVE DIRECTOR OF THE OFFICE OF CLIMATE CHANGE, SUSTAINABILITY AND RESILIENCY TO ATTEND THE 2023 USDN ANNUAL MEETING IN NEW ORLEANS, LOUISIANA FROM OCTOBER 22-25, 2023.

Latest action: Committee report and Resolution were adopted.
